Theme

Latin word

modo

modo (+ subjunctive)

adverb, with the subjunctive; modo nē, modo ut

if only, provided; just now, a moment ago; only; with a command, just …!

In this lexicon

  • as long as

    also used · classical · Lewis & Short s.v. modo

  • just now

    the recommended word · classical · Traupman 87–88; Ter. Eun. 697: Quam dūdum? — Modo.

  • only

    also used · classical · Plaut. Amph. 674: Sequere hāc mē modo; Cic. Fam. 16.11.1: modo fac, nē quid aliud cūrēs (Lewis & Short)

  • sī modo: condition

    classical

  • modo nātus: newborn

    modern

  • modo … modo: sometimes

    classical

Examples

  • Quandō? — Hodiē. — Quam dūdum? — Modo.

    When? — Today. — How long ago? — Just now.Ter. Eun. 697

    In the entry for just now

  • Sequere hāc mē modo … nē timē.

    Just follow me this way … don’t be afraid.Plaut. Amph. 674

    In the entry for only
